user.title: Connect to Tesira
user.description: Enter the SSH connection details for the Tesira Text Protocol (TTP) server on your device.

menu.title: Presets and levels
menu.description: Add the presets and level (fader) controls you want in Home Assistant. You can add or remove more later from this integration's Configure menu.

add_preset.title: Add a preset
add_preset.description: Enter the preset name exactly as it's named in the Tesira project (DEVICE recallPresetByName is case- and spelling-sensitive).

add_level.title: Add a level control
add_level.description: Enter the Instance Tag of the Level Control block (found in the Tesira design's DSP Properties), and the channel number if it has more than one. The value, min, and max are read from the device.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Tesira over SSH. Check the host, port, and credentials.
error.already_exists: That preset is already in the list.
error.tag_required: Enter the Level Control block's Instance Tag.
error.level_already_exists: That block and channel are already in the list.
error.level_not_found: Could not read a level from that block. Check the Instance Tag and channel, and that it's a Level Control block.
